meta.title: Kast: free, private résumé builder that passes ATS
meta.description: Kast is a free, open-source résumé builder that runs entirely in your browser. No account, no tracking, nothing uploaded. Ten templates, an ATS check, PDF import, and an optional AI assistant with your own key.

hero.description: Kast builds your résumé right in the browser. No account, no tracking, nothing uploaded. Style it freely; every export keeps a clean structure that applicant tracking systems read correctly.

features.heading: Everything a job search needs
features.subheading: One tool from the first draft to the tailored version you send.
features.atsBody: A 0–100 score by category with concrete fixes, plus a keyword match against the vacancy. It runs on your device.
features.importBody: Kast reads CV.lt, CV-Online, hh.ru, and builder exports, filters page clutter, and lets you check every uncertain field.
features.templatesBody: Every template has a strict ATS mode and a design mode with an accent color, icons, a photo, and a QR code.
features.languagesBody: The interface and each résumé have their own language, so you can keep one CV per market.
features.aiBody: Rewrite, tailor to a vacancy, translate, or draft a cover letter with Claude or Gemini. Personal data is masked and every change waits for your approval.
features.versionsBody: Keep a version per application, note where you sent it, and roll back to any of the last 20 snapshots.
features.offlineBody: Install Kast as an app and keep writing on a plane. Your data never leaves this device unless you export it.
features.exportBody: PDF with a real text layer, Word with real styles, plain text, JSON, YAML, and Europass XML or JSON.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subheading: The same résumé at every stage: what you type, what recruiters see, and what the parser reads back.
howItWorks.step1Description: Start from a template you like. Templates change typography, spacing, and accents; the structure underneath stays ATS-safe.
howItWorks.step2Description: Fill structured sections: experience, education, skills, languages, and more. Every change is saved in your browser and nowhere else.
howItWorks.step3Description: Download PDF, DOCX, or plain text, and any extractor reads it back in the order you wrote it.
howItWorks.liveCaption: Live render, same engine as your PDF.

closure.heading: Your next job starts with a clean page.
closure.description: Pick a template or start from a blank page. Kast is free and open source, and your résumé never leaves your browser.

footer.tagline: Private by design: your résumé never leaves your browser.

about.metaDescription: Why Kast exists, how it keeps your data private, and how it's built.
about.title: A résumé builder that minds its own business
about.lead: Kast helps you write a résumé that people enjoy reading and applicant tracking systems parse correctly, without asking who you are or keeping a copy.
about.principle1Body: There is no account and no server storage. Résumés live in your browser's IndexedDB until you export or delete them.
about.principle2Body: Templates change typography, spacing, and color. The reading order underneath never changes, so every export parses the same way.
about.principle3Body: Without a key Kast is fully functional. With one, you see exactly what's sent, personal details are masked, and nothing changes without your approval.
about.principle4Body: Kast is free software under the AGPL-3.0, built on the open-source Lanjut project. You can read, run, and improve the code.
about.builtBody: Astro and React, Tailwind CSS, TipTap for rich text, IndexedDB for storage, takumi-pdf for PDFs with a real text layer, docx for Word, and pdf.js for import. Fonts are bundled, so nothing loads from third-party servers.
about.creditsBody: Kast started as a fork of Lanjut by Rizki Maulana Citra. Thank you to everyone behind the open-source libraries it relies on.

privacy.metaDescription: What Kast stores, where, and what leaves your device.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: Short version: Kast has no accounts, no analytics, and no server that receives your résumé. Everything stays in your browser unless you export it or choose to use the AI assistant with your own key.
privacy.storedBody: Your résumés, their versions, vacancy notes, cover letters, and settings are saved in this browser's IndexedDB and local storage on your device. They are not synced or backed up by Kast. Clearing site data or using Delete all data in Settings removes them.
privacy.leavesBody: Nothing, by default. Kast loads its pages, fonts, and code once from the site you opened it from and does not call any other service. Exports are generated in the browser and saved straight to your device.
privacy.aiBody: If you add an API key and agree to send data, Kast sends the selected résumé text directly from your browser to the provider you chose (Anthropic or Google). Before sending, Kast shows the exact text and replaces email, phone, address, and links with placeholders unless you turn that off. Your photo and date of birth are never sent. The provider processes the request under its own terms and privacy policy. You can revoke consent and forget the key in Settings at any time.
privacy.keysBody: By default your key is kept only in memory for the current tab. If you choose to remember it, it is encrypted with your password (PBKDF2 and AES-GCM) and stored in this browser. Kast cannot read or recover it.
privacy.hostingBody: The server that delivers Kast's files may keep standard access logs, such as IP address and time of request, as any website does. Kast adds no cookies, trackers, or analytics.
privacy.childrenBody: Kast is not directed at children and collects no data from anyone.
privacy.changesBody: If this policy changes, the date above changes with it and the source history shows every edit.
privacy.contactBody: Open an issue in the project's source repository.
